_comment: Per-crate line coverage floors (%), checked by scripts/check-coverage.py. Ratchet: each floor is the crate's measured coverage rounded down (CI run 37050928687, coverage job 110983844454; tenet-core measured exactly 89.00 and varied by one line between runs, so it sits one point lower); raise it when coverage rises. Crates not listed use 'default'. Changed-line coverage of a PR is printed for review only.
